units.source_text: “我等下要先去天界拜访西王母，

en.t: I am going up to heaven first to visit the Queen Mother of the West,

units.source_text: 你暂时坐在这里等我回来。

en.t: so sit here for the time being and wait for me to return.

units.source_text: 可能会一些魔障出现在你身边，想要骗你。

en.t: some demonic obstacles may appear beside you and try to deceive you.

units.source_text: 不管发生什么事情，你都得默不出声。

en.t: No matter what happens, you must remain silent and not make a sound.

units.source_text: 你要明白，只要你说出一个字，

en.t: You must understand that if you utter even a single word,

units.source_text: 你就再也没机会成仙了。

en.t: you will never again have the chance to become an immortal.

units.source_text: 就算是天塌地陷，你也要缄默不言。”

en.t: Even if the heavens collapse and the earth splits open, you must keep silent and say nothing.”
